author: The Critical Drinker
description:
In the first video essay I've done for a while, join me as I analyse the deeper themes and messaging of the 1992 Clint Eastwood classic, Unforgiven. Arguably the greatest Western of all time, and a movie that proved it IS possible to respectfully deconstruct the tropes of a genre, while also rebuilding it into something more meaningful.
